propositions: The packaged CLI overview (rebar --help) and maintained ticket-model documentation incorrectly state that unlink accepts no optional relation argument, contradicting the actual shipped library and CLI implementation that accepts [relation].

The relation-scoped unlink feature was added to the core library and CLI with corresponding help/guide updates in commit 73abb5805f, but independently maintained overview.txt and ticket-model.md surfaces were not updated and retain pre-change wording.
The event-schema.md documentation uses obsolete operation wording that fails to distinguish the optional relation selector from the emitted link-UUID cancellation in the UNLINK event payload.

When relation is omitted, unlink falls back to the most-recent relation on the pair; when explicit relation is provided, exactly that relation is removed while preserving other active relations on the pair.

The repair updates overview and ticket-model surfaces to document unlink <source> <target> [relation], preserves the omitted-selector fallback contract, and corrects event-schema semantics without changing any runtime behavior.
